hypothesis: At a FIXED 12-mode Grassmann encoder, live activation-grounded phi over the resident 32B's residual stream leaves an integration fraction at or above the 0.10 floor, with p < 0.05 against the shuffled-transition null, replicated across fresh boots and conversation loads.
notes: Registered BEFORE the replication runs, and specifically before any further width sweeping. The 2026-08-04 campaign selected width 12 after observing 8/12/16 on a single run; the best of three arms is also the expected shape of noise, so that result is EXPLORATORY and core/consciousness/phi_core.py stamps every phi measured at a non-preregistered width accordingly. Widening the encoder is not free: grassmann_fold_collision_rate measures 0.938 of 12-bit states sharing a folded byte (0.996 at 16 bits), so a 12-mode phi is a phi over a finer PARTITION of the dynamics, not over 12 intact modes. Changing any parameter above makes the run a different experiment and every metric in it exploratory — that is the point.
